status: Final locked handover; complete authoring data after PR854 and PR858
scope: Template content and focused clone/prog integration. No live world, character, repository or database changes are included in this deliverable.

native_field_mapping.PrivilegeNames: Bitwise OR of existing ClanPrivilegeType enum members
native_field_mapping.Title: one unconditional title row, Order=0

defaults_and_simplifications.rank_model: Ordination in Church/diocese/parish; profession in religious institutions; leadership is appointment.
defaults_and_simplifications.religious_franchise: All active professed members of the relevant clan, one vote each. A stated compact-game substitute for representative chapters.
defaults_and_simplifications.religious_tenure: Indefinite for native elected offices, regardless of modern order-specific fixed terms.
defaults_and_simplifications.papal_voting: Indefinite plurality election, earlier join date breaking equal positive vote totals at this engine baseline. Manual-conclave alternative is fully specified.
defaults_and_simplifications.religious_resignation: Immediate native resignation is enabled as a gameplay convenience.
defaults_and_simplifications.ecclesial_accepted_resignation: CanResign=false blocks immediate resignation; PR858 also prevents non-administrator self-dismissal through ordinary and external dismissal routes. Request/acceptance is roleplay followed by an authorised distinct actor using the proper local or liege removal route, not a native pending-request queue. Administrators retain an override.
defaults_and_simplifications.council: Four advisory seats; consent, veto or co-signing of managerial acts is not enforced.
defaults_and_simplifications.capacities: Positive engine capacities are chosen to work at the reviewed baseline; they are not canonical size limits.
defaults_and_simplifications.periods: 10080 stored minutes each for nomination/voting; zero lead time; game-calendar scheduling. No assumption that every game has an Earth calendar.
defaults_and_simplifications.named_order_era: Historically recognisable core. Modern legal texts support structural distinctions but do not certify a complete 1511 constitution.
defaults_and_simplifications.no_modern_branch_expansion: No Jesuit, Capuchin, Discalced Carmelite, Trappist or universal Benedictine Confederation template is included in this release.

live_binding_invariants: Every binding resolves to an explicit live clan and an active existing office record where required; no template office is a valid live authority.

All bound institutions in one Church network must use the same live Church. In particular parish.church must equal parish.diocese.church, and house/province/order/mother-authority Church bindings must agree.

Where a superior is selected through the canonical_superior role, supply both the actual live clan ID and actual appointment ID; selected_office is a required input placeholder, not a literal office name.
Reject self-confirmation and cyclic confirmation/parent/controlled-superior dependencies introduced by provisioning.
External authorities may be unoccupied, in which case confirmation remains pending; never replace a vacant authority with an arbitrary ancestor or bypass approval.
For an existing live source, retaining external references is a deliberate explicit reuse choice; never silently assume a new clone belongs to a newly cloned Church.
The input graph or retained world provisioning record must preserve each actual live binding; these authoring records are not new native Clan or Appointment fields.
base_eligibility: Character is the active, living primary identity being evaluated.
Character has a non-archived membership in the actual destination clan.

The Catholic template activation workflow has completed with no automatic founder membership; all required live bindings still resolve to the intended live clans and existing office records whenever eligibility is evaluated. An office may validly be vacant.
If this is not the universal Church, character has active membership in its explicitly bound live Church.

minimum_rank: Resolve MinimumRankKey to this live clan rank object, then compare runtime rank number >= its current runtime ordinal.
bishop_cardinal: Local rank is the resolved bishop rank.
Holds this same live Church cardinal appointment.
priest_canon: Local rank is at least the resolved priest rank.
Holds this same live clan cathedral_canon appointment.
bishop: Local rank is the resolved bishop rank.

cardinals: Holds this same live Church cardinal appointment.
canons: Holds this same live clan cathedral_canon appointment.
professed: Local rank is at least the resolved professed rank. No extra votes for superior or council offices.

church_member: Active membership in the explicitly bound live Church; no ordination requirement.
church_deacon: Active bound Church membership at or above its resolved deacon rank.
church_priest: Active bound Church membership at or above its resolved priest rank.
church_bishop: Active bound Church membership at its resolved bishop rank.
church_cardinal: Active membership in the local universal Church and holds its cardinal appointment.
same_holder_as_local_ordinary: Already holds this live clan ordinary appointment.

evaluation.candidate_combination: All base eligibility AND all candidate-profile conditions AND QualificationRule.
evaluation.vote_combination: All base eligibility AND all voter-profile conditions; return integer 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
evaluation.why_not: Return the first failed condition in readable language; return an empty string when eligible.
evaluation.multiple_memberships: Count the same primary character once; status in another unbound Church or religious house gives no vote.
evaluation.numeric_ranks: Never embed seeded literal RankNumber thresholds: FinaliseLoad normalises them. Resolve source rank keys to cloned records before generating progs.
evaluation.qualification_changes: Nomination is the automatic full-qualification checkpoint. PR858 promotes an installed winner below MinimumRankToHold using SetRank and reconciles the direct paygrade; it does not re-run CanNominate or cross-clan qualifications. Catholic nominees must already meet ordination/profession minima. Before changing a pending candidate qualification or required binding, resolve the affected ballot through supported workflow; a pending confirmed slate may be vetoed. Ordinary player withdrawal is limited to Nomination. The domain WithdrawNomination API can remove a nominee from a nonfinalised ballot and revoke changed-slate approval, but no stock late-withdraw FutureProg builtin is assumed. Raw administrative edits can bypass this content policy; unattended final-install qualification enforcement is outside the stock data contract.

invariants: No stock template has a live roster, live election history, bank balance, assets or reserved external slots.
All rank/appointment names, aliases, keys, references and positive holder capacities are explicit.
Every governing permission is appointment-based; no ecclesial rank includes induction, promotion, finance or personnel powers.

No privilege mask is All; no office or rank includes blanket CanManageClanVassals, rank demotion, rank creation or clan disbanding. Only religious superior appointments grant formation/profession promotion and rank-path changes; no ecclesial office grants ordination-rank promotion.
External confirmation references in JSON are symbolic provisioning instructions, not IDs to write pointing at another template.
Every elected office has finite positive nomination/voting durations, a zero lead time, explicit candidate and vote progs and an explicit holder cap.
Every stock recall policy is false with null recall progs and dormant threshold 0.5.
Every external direct appointment is preceded by membership, rank and additional qualification checks; the runtime command itself can auto-induct/promote.
Every Catholic nominee already meets the intended rank and additional qualifications; native election-winner promotion is never used to confer ordination or religious profession.

Template election configuration is natively inert. A live clone loads fresh election cycles after founding state and CreatedClan; Catholic binding, prog generation and founder policy must finish before that startup, or remain in a deliberate supported staging state.
The native Appointees ledger, not only a reservation, records externally appointed holder provenance; initial externally appointed incumbents must use that route.
No ordinary-election supermajority is claimed. RecallThreshold is not an election threshold.
No custom native EF field is implied by key, QualificationRule, live_bindings, AppointmentRoute, source_ids or other authoring metadata.

review_delta.content_policy_change: None: the agreed template structures, office flags, capacities, franchise and tenure defaults are retained.
replaced_findings: Generic template election inertness is native.
Non-administrator ordinary/external self-dismissal cannot bypass resignation.
Ordinary non-administrator dismissal cannot remove a holder recorded as an external appointee.
Installed election winners now receive minimum-rank promotion; old statements that installation ignores the office minimum are obsolete.
Supported appointment deletion now completes both-sided external-control and ballot/listener cleanup.
still_required_for_content: Catholic electorate marker recognition and per-live-clan prog generation.
World-specific authority binding and activation before native live election startup.
Explicit ordinary/external appointment qualification preflight and pending-candidate change workflow.
review_delta.verification_scope: Pinned-source review and local catalogue consistency checks. No engine build, runtime suite, MySQL import or in-game smoke was run for this final handover.

native_runtime_contracts.template_lifecycle: IsTemplate=true prevents election/recall activity and suspends stored listeners without deleting history. Returning to live resumes stored state and initializes missing cycles. Fresh clones do not copy election rows, dates, nominees or votes.
clone_order: Copy rank, appointment and election configuration; rebind same-clan confirmation references.
Apply founding membership and CreatedClan hook.
native_runtime_contracts.generic_founder: The current generic clone gives its actor the highest source rank and the first appointment with Privileges exactly All. No All mask avoids automatic office assignment but does not prevent the highest-rank membership.
native_runtime_contracts.ordinary_appointment: Existing active local member; below-minimum rank rejected; authoring qualifications are not a native callback.
native_runtime_contracts.confirmer_direct_appointment: Same ordinary holder-minimum and capacity checks; enabled confirmer gets appointment AND dismissal, not a dismissal-only right.
native_runtime_contracts.external_appointment: May induct/reactivate and raise local rank; Catholic preflight requires existing qualified membership instead.
native_runtime_contracts.elected_installation: After applicable confirmation and free-capacity checks, a winner below MinimumRankToHold is raised via SetRank immediately before installation. Higher ranks are not lowered; pending/unseated winners are not promoted. Additional nomination predicates are not rerun.
native_runtime_contracts.promotion_paygrade: Only when SetRank is invoked: retain an allowed direct paygrade, else use the new rank lowest-amount linked paygrade or null. Stock Catholic data defines no paygrades.
native_runtime_contracts.self_dismissal: Both ordinary and external dismissal reject non-administrator self-removal and instruct the caller to resign. They do not internally execute resignation. Administrators retain an override.
native_runtime_contracts.external_holder_dismissal: Matching external-control Appointees membership blocks ordinary non-administrator dismissal, including otherwise authorised parent/confirmer actors. Use the applicable liege external-dismissal route. A reservation alone does not mark a holder externally appointed.
native_runtime_contracts.ordinary_confirmation: One exact configured office; its active holders or administrators confirm/veto the whole slate. Ancestors and general privileges do not substitute.
native_runtime_contracts.parent_dismissal: For elected offices with CanParentDismiss, the exact immediate parent holder receives that dismissal permission, still subject to self/external-holder and other relevant restrictions.
native_runtime_contracts.recall_confirmation: Configured election confirmer, if any, AND all matching external relationships under which the target is an appointee. Each liege requires authorised CanManageClanVassals or holder/controller authority; no such broad flag is added to Catholic data. One actor may satisfy several authorities. Administrator override is preserved.
native_runtime_contracts.recall_state: Partial liege approvals persist and changed control authority invalidates its approval. Elections.RecallLiegeApprovals is runtime state, never a template field or a value to seed.
native_runtime_contracts.deletion: Deletion is refused while any election-confirmation or job-listing reference remains. After those are addressed, supported deletion removes holders, child-parent links, budgets, chargen grants, controls on both sides, appointment rows and its elections/listeners. It does not preserve the deleted appointment own ballot history.
native_runtime_contracts.capacity: GetVacantAppointmentSlots still returns zero for MaximumSimultaneousHolders < 1. Use the positive catalogue caps.
native_runtime_contracts.ordinary_vote_rule: Positive vote totals ordered descending; earlier clan JoinDate breaks ties. RecallThreshold has no effect on ordinary elections.
native_runtime_contracts.qualification_boundary: No generic holder-qualification callback, automatic cross-clan standing sync, or unattended complete Catholic revalidation is supplied by these native features.

content_integration_contract.field_status: This entire object is authoring/workflow metadata, not a new native Clan or Appointment schema.
content_integration_contract.stock_installation: Additive InstallMissing; stable Name/Alias identities; no members, external reservations, election rows, money or assets.
content_integration_contract.founder_policy: Suppress generic automatic founder membership for these explicit Catholic template profiles. Initial characters and their actual ranks are separate intentional live inputs. Preserve the existing CreatedClan hook; do not replace a world global hook to implement this policy.
content_integration_contract.prog_generation: Recognise the CatholicTemplate_v1 profile markers explicitly. Generate deterministic live progs using resolved clan/rank/appointment IDs and the declared predicate contracts. Current AllMembers/Councillor/Board rebinding does not implement Catholic Cardinal/Canon/Professed rules. Regenerate optional recall progs separately.

generated_prog_metadata.FunctionComment: Include source template key, appointment key, profile version and resolved live binding identities.

content_integration_contract.activation: Finish founder handling, bindings, qualification preflight, prog generation and validation before native post-hook LoadElections. If required world inputs are missing, use an explicit staged copy kept IsTemplate=true with fail-closed progs; return it to live only when ready. Merely returning zero votes in a live clan does not stop empty ballots/timers. Do not add a second scheduler or overwrite a shared creation hook.
content_integration_contract.binding_record: Retain the source template key, live clone ID, rank/appointment key-to-ID map, selected variants, actual live binding IDs and generated prog IDs in the provisioning input/result. This is an authoring record; no mandatory new runtime schema is requested.
content_integration_contract.pending_qualification_change: Resolve affected nominations/results before changing a required rank, qualifying office, Church membership or authority binding. Player withdrawal is Nomination-only; pending confirmed results may be vetoed. If a scoped content tool is supplied for a later targeted withdrawal, use the existing domain WithdrawNomination API and preserve its changed-slate approval behaviour. Do not invent a stock command or FutureProg builtin. Unattended final-install revalidation is outside this specification.
content_integration_contract.external_holder_provenance: Install initial externally appointed incumbents through the external-control route so the native Appointees ledger is correct. Do not add them only to Membership.Appointments and assume the reservation grants removal protection.
content_integration_contract.configuration_changes: Preserve current live history. Resolve relevant pending ballots before changing governance; intentionally rebind or clear authorities through supported operations and regenerate affected progs. No raw-row deletion or template rerun reconciliation.
content_integration_contract.legacy_source: The unfinished The Catholic Church entry and trailing blank definition appear in the user-uploaded draft, not pinned master. If present in the implementation checkout, supersede those unfinished source definitions. Never rename/delete an existing database clan or live clone with that legacy name.
